# Steady Steps Music

> Private music lessons in Boise, Idaho, taught by Nik Mathews (20+ years teaching). Guitar, bass, piano, voice, songwriting, and music theory for kids 9+ and adults at every skill level. Lessons are online by Zoom anywhere, or in person around the Treasure Valley (Boise, Garden City, Meridian, Eagle). The first lesson is a free 15-minute demo.

## About the teaching
- Lessons are built around what the student actually wants to play, with no one-size-fits-all curriculum.
- Ear-first approach: learn songs you love, build muscle memory, then use theory to understand what you're playing.
- Every lesson ends with a written recap of what was covered, plus practice sheets (chord charts, tabs, scales) made for that student.
- Good fit for adult beginners, returning players, singers who want to accompany themselves on guitar or piano, songwriters, and kids starting their first instrument.

## Pricing
- Free 15-minute demo lesson (Zoom), no commitment
- 30-minute lesson: $50
- 60-minute lesson: $90
- Save 10% with monthly prepay
- In-home lessons add a $15 travel fee per session
